env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# Issue 28035: bolero test -c -o NUL should work.
# Issue 28549: bolero test -c -o /dev/null should not overwrite /dev/null when run as root.
cd x
cmp $devnull $WORK/empty.txt
bolero test -o=$devnull -c
! exists x.test$GOEXE
cmp $devnull $WORK/empty.txt

# Issue 12407: bolero build -o /dev/null should succeed.
cd ..
bolero build -o $devnull y
cmp $devnull $WORK/empty.txt

}
-- y/y.go --
package y
